name: rollcall_vpedestrian
about: Roll call: classname npc_VPedestrian builds CNPC_VPedestrian (factory 0x103a1cb0, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). One row taken verbatim from sm_hub_1 (havenbum) stands in the arena; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
known_red: 5: the StartHidden row thinks while hidden (cond+ FLOATING_OFF_GROUND at t=0.00, before the 0.5 s ScriptUnhide; retail PostSpawn 0x100aaf30 -> ScriptHide 0x100a8710 parks the think at FLT_MAX)
notes: Every standable row of npc_VPedestrian is StartHidden; the record unhides it at 0.5 s, as its map's wire does. V2 (2026-10-04): the two nevers before 0.45 s are retail -- CBaseEntity::PostSpawn 0x100aaf30 runs slot 77 ScriptHide 0x100a8710 for m_bStartHidden, which saves m_pfnThink, installs NULL and parks m_flNextThink at FLT_MAX until ScriptUnhide 0x100a8990: a hidden row senses and selects nothing; without them the roll call passed on known red 5 (FALL_TO_GROUND selected while hidden).
